subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Which model-facing append API should OpenClaw expose for ordinary agent file writes: `append?: boolean` on `write`, a string `mode`, or a separate append tool?
rationale: The source and user reports establish the need for an append primitive, but the permanent tool contract is a maintainer-owned product/API decision and PR #77127 already implements one option.

options.title: Accept `append?: boolean` on `write`
options.body: Land PR #77127 or equivalent after exact-head review if maintainers want the smallest backwards-compatible extension to the existing tool.

options.title: Switch to `mode`
options.body: Require the candidate PR to replace the boolean with an explicit mode field if maintainers prefer a more extensible write contract.

options.title: Use a dedicated append tool
options.body: Keep ordinary `write` overwrite-only and request a separate append tool if maintainers want stricter operation separation.

recommendation.title: Accept `append?: boolean` on `write`
recommendation.body: Land PR #77127 or equivalent after exact-head review if maintainers want the smallest backwards-compatible extension to the existing tool.

likelyOwner.reason: They appear closest to the agent runtime/tool API ownership and product boundary decisions behind this surface.
